timeline: You might assume dumping old wooden accounting records is harmless, but doing exactly that destroyed the Palace of Westminster on October 16, 1834.
Irish labourers shove tallies into furnace at dawn.
Flames lick copper flues, sparks rise.
Heat spreads through stone floor, smoke thickens.
Tourists notice thick smoke and feel unusual heat through their boots.
Flashover erupts, giant ball of flame.
Roof collapses, plaster rains down hard.
Now you see why waste mattered.
